text: The subject, Waqas Mirza (PK**BAHL****9631), received a series of high‑value inbound IBFT transfers from at least eight distinct counterparties between 3 April and 10 April 2026, totalling PKR 580,000 (58,000 + 60,000 + 26,000 + 93,000 + 23,000 + 72,000 + 82,000 + 49,000). Within a short window, the same account transferred PKR 178,000 on 9 April and PKR 173,000 on 12 April 2026 to a QuickPay e‑wallet (WLT****0932) via wallet‑transfer channels. The outbound amounts represent more than 95 % of the inbound funds and were moved to a non‑bank wallet, a pattern typical of a “border mule” where funds are quickly funneled out of the banking system. The typology engine flagged the case (score 360, above the alert threshold of 300) for “many distinct inbound counterparties in 14 days” and “large share of inbound value leaves quickly”. The subject’s declared monthly income (PKR 90,000) and low risk rating are inconsistent with the volume and speed of transactions. No sanctions, PEP or adverse media matches were found, but the transaction pattern alone justifies filing a Suspicious Transaction Report.
